sources.title: Duchy of Łęczyca
sources.note: Łęczyca created around 1231 by Konrad I of Masovia; Sieradz split off in 1264; Łęczyca incorporated 1352.

notes:
Duchy of Sieradz is a state Cliopatria lacks (eu-15-d asked for it as 'Duchy of Łęczyca-Sieradz'). Neither page names the land: the 70 km radius is a stand-in for the later Sieradz Voivodeship. Wars: none are named on either page.

Not settled: (1) 1263 (Sieradz page) against 1264 (Łęczyca page). (2) The infobox predecessor Duchy of Kuyavia against the body's Łęczyca. (3) The vassal relation to the Polish crown (1305, infobox; 'fiefdom of the Polish Crown (from 1306)') belongs to the Polish overlord's ledger. (4) The Łęczyca duchy of 1231-1352 (its last duke Władysław the Hunchback, incorporated 1352 per the Łęczyca page) is not a Cliopatria row and needs a dossier; the Cliopatria slug duchy-of-eczyca holds only 1138-1144. (5) The gain and loss counterparts kingdom-of-bohemia and kingdom-of-poland should carry the matching events.
